title: De novo identification of potent ingredients for proteasome activation in MT101-5 using an AI-driven approach.
authors: Kim, Sinyeon; Han, Manyoung; Kim, Se Woong; Choi, Jin Gyu; Park, Sang Cheol; Choi, Soo In; Son, Miwon; Lee, Doheon
one_liner_zh: 该文利用AI网络分析鉴定帕金森病中药活性成分以激活蛋白酶体，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the intracellular accumulation of alpha-synuclein (alpha-syn) protein within Lewy bodies, which are hallmark neuropathological lesions of alpha-synucleinopathies. Network analysis, incorporating prior knowledge such as biological pathways and gene expression data from patients with PD, was used to identify the pharmaceutically active ingredients of MT101-5 and elucidate their mechanisms of action related to proteasome activation in PD. To validate the artificial intelligence (AI) model's prediction that API-mediated alpha-syn aggregate clearance occurs through enhanced proteasome activity, we employed a reporter-based screening to assess proteasome function within the ubiquitin-proteasome system. Our findings demonstrated that diterpenes derived from Genkwae Flos in MT101-5 inhibited alpha-syn fibril formation by restoring proteasome activation through Nurr1 activity. Two diterpenoids mitigated behavioural deficits and dopaminergic neuron loss in mice subjected to subacute MPTP administration (30 mg/kg/day for 5 days). These results provide preliminary evidence supporting the therapeutic potential of the active ingredients in MT101-5 for the prevention or treatment of PD.
abstract_zh: 帕金森病（Parkinson's disease, PD）是一种神经退行性疾病，其特征是α-突触核蛋白（alpha-synuclein, alpha-syn）在路易小体（Lewy bodies）内细胞内积累，而路易小体是α-突触核蛋白病（alpha-synucleinopathies）的标志性神经病理损伤。通过整合先验知识（如生物学通路和来自PD患者的基因表达数据）的网络分析，被用于识别MT101-5中的药物活性成分，并阐明其与PD中蛋白酶体激活相关的作用机制。为了验证人工智能（AI）模型预测的API介导的α-syn聚集体清除通过增强蛋白酶体活性实现，我们采用了基于报告基因的筛选来评估泛素-蛋白酶体系统内的蛋白酶体功能。我们的研究结果表明，源自MT101-5中芫花（Genkwae Flos）的二萜类化合物通过Nurr1活性恢复蛋白酶体激活，从而抑制α-syn纤维形成。两种二萜类化合物减轻了接受亚急性MPTP给药（30 mg/kg/天，持续5天）的小鼠的行为缺陷和多巴胺能神经元损失。这些结果提供了初步证据，支持MT101-5中活性成分在预防或治疗PD方面的治疗潜力。
